name: Discord Server Insights
description: Discord Server Insights is an aggregate analytics dashboard for eligible Community Servers. It reports growth and activation, engagement, audience, announcement-channel, and onboarding trends while applying Discord's privacy thresholds.
agentUseSummary: Discord Server Insights cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because Discord publishes dashboard access and a guild permission but no supported API, delegated OAuth resource, export endpoint, or remote MCP contract for the insight datasets.

blocked.label: Connect Server Insights
blocked.description: Discord does not publish a supported application authorization contract for Server Insights datasets.

blocked.label: Read Server Insights analytics
blocked.description: Discord documents the dashboard and VIEW_GUILD_INSIGHTS permission but no REST, Gateway, OAuth resource, or remote MCP endpoint that returns the dashboard analytics.

blocked.label: Automate the private dashboard
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot reuse a user's Discord web session, call private client endpoints, or scrape dashboard charts and CSV exports.

blocked.label: Substitute synthetic bot telemetry
blocked.description: Prospectively collecting bot events is a separate analytics product and cannot be represented as Discord's privacy-thresholded Server Insights dataset.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Server Insights actions can be enabled until Discord publishes a supported distributable analytics API or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Discord Server Insights API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Discord Server Insights API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Discord exposes Server Insights only through its authenticated dashboard for eligible Community Servers. Its developer documentation defines VIEW_GUILD_INSIGHTS but publishes no endpoint, scope, schema, export API, rate limit, webhook, or remote MCP contract for the aggregate insight data.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request a Discord bot token or user session for Server Insights and do not show Connect. Reconsider only if Discord publishes an officially supported Server Insights API or remote MCP service for third-party applications.

evidence.supports: Discord documents dashboard-only growth, engagement, audience, announcement, and welcome analytics, eligibility and privacy thresholds, plus interactive CSV export for authorized users.
Discord defines the VIEW_GUILD_INSIGHTS permission bit but does not pair it with an insight resource or retrieval endpoint.
Discord's official REST and Gateway developer reference publishes application APIs and authentication conventions but no Server Insights analytics resource.
Discord's supported Guild resource exposes server metadata, members, roles, integrations and other administrative resources but no Server Insights chart dataset.
Discord identifies Server Insights as a user-facing Community Server administration tool rather than a developer integration surface.
